page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via KVM virtualization. The system features 56 dedicated vCPUs paired with 224 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4 GB RAM per vCPU. Compute and graphics processing are augmented by two discrete NVIDIA P100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 32 GB of VRAM. Additionally, the instance is equipped with 944 GB of local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

By integrating high-density CPU resources alongside dual discrete graphics accelerators, this configuration targets heavy parallel processing workloads without requiring separate storage nodes. The bundled 944 GB local SSD provides low-latency disk access for temporary dataset staging, while 10 Gbps network bandwidth maintains steady data transfer rates across clusters. However, the reliance on Pascal-generation NVIDIA P100 accelerators represents a legacy GPU architecture, which offers lower processing efficiency compared to modern accelerator families.

The instance is suited for parallel computing tasks, scientific simulations, deep learning inference, image processing pipelines, and GPU-driven rendering workloads. Its combination of 56 vCPUs and 224 GB RAM supports demanding pre-processing and post-processing steps directly on the same host system.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated cloud server designed for compute-intensive and parallel processing workloads. Powered by an x86_64 CPU architecture managed via KVM virtualization, the instance includes 56 dedicated vCPUs and 224 GB of system memory, yielding a 4 GB RAM per vCPU allocation. Hardware acceleration is provided by two NVIDIA P100 GPUs offering 32 GB of combined VRAM. Local storage is catered by a bundled 944 GB SSD, supplemented by a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The presence of dual GPUs alongside substantial host memory and dedicated CPU cores supports complex matrix calculations, computer vision tasks, video encoding, and deep learning inference pipelines. While the NVIDIA P100 architecture offers strong single and double-precision floating-point performance, it lacks modern specialized tensor processing cores, representing a technical design tradeoff for high-throughput model training.
